summary: AI-powered long-form video generation platform supporting 15-minute cinematic videos with Sora integration, voiceover, script writing, sound effects, and music
architectural_notes: Web-based platform for AI video generation
Integration with Sora API for video generation
Multi-modal AI pipeline: script → voiceover → video → audio effects

existing_features.title: Create a landing page that introduces the platform's capabilities: Sora-powered video generation, cinematic quality output up to 15 minutes, AI script writing, professional voiceover, sound effects, and music integration
Implement a video project creation workflow where users can input their requirements: video concept, desired length (up to 15 minutes), style preferences, and target audience
Create an AI script writing interface where users can generate or refine video scripts with parameters for tone, pacing, and narrative structure
Build a voiceover configuration module where users can select voice characteristics (gender, accent, tone) and generate professional-quality narration from the script
Implement a sound effects library browser where users can search, preview, and select sound effects to enhance their video
Create a music selection interface where users can browse background music tracks by mood, genre, and tempo, with options to customize music for their video length
Build a video generation status dashboard that displays progress for Sora-based video rendering, including stages for script processing, voiceover generation, visual rendering, and audio mixing
Implement a video project library where users can view all their created projects with thumbnails, titles, duration, creation date, and status (draft, generating, completed)
Create a video player and download interface for completed videos, showing the final cinematic output with all integrated elements (visuals, voiceover, sound effects, music)

Design a cohesive visual theme that conveys professional cinematic quality with a modern, sophisticated aesthetic using a color palette of deep teals, warm golds, and charcoal grays; typography should use a clean sans-serif for UI elements paired with an elegant serif for headings; layouts should emphasize spaciousness and clarity with card-based designs and smooth animations
